name: R-Group (R-COM)
summary: Perth managed IT/telecom services provider (R Group International, ex-RNAS International, founded 2000); R-COM was its VoIP/communications brand, R-BOX its hosting brand; now a licensed carrier serving mine sites. Not a consumer ISP.

events.details: Founded in Perth as R-NAS (Remote Network Administration Services); RNAS International Pty Ltd registered Jan 2001.
